name: HCB Hierarchy Consumer B
brief: Level-3 consumer: depends on the shared library AND sideways on consumer A, its co-dependent.
description: The first app in this bundle that depends on a sibling which itself depends on another sibling — HCB -> HCA -> HSL is the bundle's first transitive chain, and HCB -> {HSL, HCA} its first diamond. Contributes: a Contribute() that forwards through HCA into the library, a broadcast subscriber, a tableextension on the SHARED LIBRARY's table (a second app extending the same sibling-owned table as HCA), an enumextension on the shared library's enum, and a sideways read of HCA's extension field on a row HCA inserted. See HTS Hierarchy Tests.
